note: `beforeEpoch: 1`. Nothing is below epoch 1, so a prune asking for it is a caller who has the direction backwards; refused rather than answered `pruned: 0`.
No presentation. Pruning ends the room's ability to read part of its past for every member; it is authorized by `admin` the room conferred, never by an account at the host.
A response without the epoch floor. The floor is what members' key holders discard below, and what a host must keep; a 0.2 response that omits it has told nobody what to forget.
A floor of 0. Epochs start at 1; a floor below the first epoch is no floor, and absent is how a never-pruned room says so elsewhere — a prune always leaves one.
